prayer: Prayer:- Writ petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, calling for the records of the respondents in connection with the impugned order passed by the 1st respondent in C. No. PR98/H1(2)/2012 u/r3(b) dated 27.08.2013 and confirmed by the 2nd respondent in C. No. B2/AP.70/13000/2013 dated 23.10.2013 and further confirmed by the 3rd respondent in his Rc. judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

M. Dhandapani, J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this Writ Petition with liberty to file a fresh petition and he has also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. In view of the endorsement so made, this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs.
